# Zvirox

> Local-first open-source Linux desktop software and Android TV tools.

Zvirox is maintained solo by Prakashpuri Gauswami (@zvirox) in Patan, Gujarat, India. The project publishes six native Linux desktop apps written in Rust, Tauri 2, and React 19, plus an Android TV launcher and rootless ADB cleanup toolkit. Every binary ships from public GitHub Actions builds with SHA-256 checksums and sends zero telemetry.

Website: https://zvirox.in
Contact: info@zvirox.in | zvirox@proton.me
GitHub Organization: https://github.com/zvirox

## Downloads Hub & Per-App Releases

- [Downloads Hub](https://zvirox.in/downloads/): Categorized Linux Apps (.deb, .rpm, .pkg.tar.zst) and Android TV (.apk) directory with SHA-256 verification.
